> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **57** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a121e29c280aefb60fdbd48f3f765c5dc8902884` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ae362da6d115afaf684eddf85eaf5fe5ae459277` — the merge of head `9b0824ae367aa8d525b7da230ea86077c70a96ed` into base `a121e29c280aefb60fdbd48f3f765c5dc8902884`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ae362da6d115afaf684eddf85eaf5fe5ae459277 && git checkout ae362da6d115afaf684eddf85eaf5fe5ae459277
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a121e29c280aefb60fdbd48f3f765c5dc8902884 9b0824ae367aa8d525b7da230ea86077c70a96ed && git checkout -B drift-repro a121e29c280aefb60fdbd48f3f765c5dc8902884 && git merge --no-ff 9b0824ae367aa8d525b7da230ea86077c70a96ed

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a121e29c280aefb60fdbd48f3f765c5dc8902884
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a121e29c280aefb60fdbd48f3f765c5dc8902884` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · PR #34419 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T16:49Z
Head-sha: `7bf9cf500fca0a5d1d9a35207e533d576e438d2a`

**L1 · ACCEPT** · area o1-E 定稿评论 6922829814 所钉 head。merge-base `898655a9`,5 个提交加 1 个 main 合并,9 个文件。合并前后 PR 自身 diff 的 `git patch-id --stable` 相同(`5923c475…`)。

- **PR 形态**:`Fixes #34095`。PR 只做平台这一半;cloud 那一半(`upgradeSideOf`)按卡面原文「The cloud seat files or takes that half once the platform shape is settled」交给 cloud 席位,去处有据。
- **代码与 registry 的折叠一致**:`objectsByName` 把扩展按 `priority ?? 200` 升序折叠,同 priority 时按列出顺序,字段按名整条覆盖,目标就是 `extend` 原文。这与 `engine-registration.ts:324`(`ext.priority ?? 200`)、`registry-object-registration.ts:630`(升序 sort)、`registry.ts` 中 `mergeObjectDefinitions` 的 `{ ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }` 一致。added/removed 只看自有对象,只经扩展到达的对象只比较字段,不会列为新增或删除对象。`os diff` 对只经扩展到达的对象,label 比较前判空,不会解引用 undefined。
- **changeset 逐句核对**:BREAKING 段(扩展字段改类型,或删一个同时加一个,都会 409)由 install-local 门的两条用例 pin 住。`--confirm-upgrade` 在 `deploy.ts` 和 `package/install.ts` 都有。「Before … listed no added field」与卡面 6.2.0 → 6.4.0 的读数一致。`PackageUpgradeSide.objectExtensions` 是可选键,不带该键时计划不变,有 CONTROL pin。`fieldPatches` 不参与比较。adr-0087 not-required 注释的理由成立:没有可编写键变化,也没有存储行变化。
- **席位路线 ②(核过)**:引用的裁决记录 6709061297 是 #30884 PR 2 的维护者裁决,第 (ii) 条原文为「removed fields and seed changes are reported only」。`package-upgrade-verdict.ts:121-122` 的「Removed fields, removed objects, `safe` type changes and seed changes are reported by a dry run and refused by nothing」逐字在源码中。#34095 卡上的说明评论 6922813677 引文准确,也写明这是席位决定、不是新裁决。扩展字段被单独删除时只列出不拒,与自有字段一致。
- **席位路线 ①(核过)**:「偏向多要一次确认,不会漏掉一次」这一句,本 L1 另外核了反方向:新版本开始重声明外包拥有的字段并改其类型时,计划只会把它列为 added。这种改动在 install-local 门的 2e′ 一步(ADR-0146 D10 的显示属性白名单,`judgeRedeclaredOwnerFields`)就被 422 拒了,重声明只能改显示属性。所以计划漏掉的只有显示属性,不涉及存储列,原句成立。
- **拒收测试**:两条 409 用例都断言了 `status` 409 与 `code` `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`,也断言了 findings 与「什么都没写」。红绿与 ablation 读数在正文中,四个源文件各自回退后变红。
- **范围外**:dev 报告中另一条(`marketplace-install-declared-renames.ts` 的 `extensionTarget` 读别名键)理由是「not exercised」。`ObjectExtensionSchema` 只有 `extend` 一个键,别名读到的是不会通过 parse 的拼法,所以这条理由可以接受。
- **门禁**:本 head 共 55 条 check-runs,37 条 `success`、18 条 `skipped`,0 条失败,包括 Test Core 1–8 与聚合 job、Lint 与 Type Check 各分片、Dogfood Regression Gate、Check Changeset、Governed Surface Queue Guard。
- **battery**:标题带 `!`,narrowing。dev 报告 6922677907 的全量 battery 钉在 `7bf9cf50`:VERDICT command-exit 0,`Test Files 475 passed | 3 skipped`,`Tests 4018 passed | 42 skipped`。

落地条款:非受管路径,由区线程落地;须同时具备本 ACCEPT、review#2 的 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS(已认领)、钉在本 head 的 battery,以及 narrowing 落地前 `label-write --land` 的核对。再合 main 会移动 head,battery 须在新 head 重跑。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7bf9cf500fca0a5d1d9a35207e533d576e438d2a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-core/src/package-upgrade-plan.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/package-upgrade-plan.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/package-upgrade-environment.ts, packages/objectql/src/package-upgrade-environment.test.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-rename-planner.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-upgrade-plan.test.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts, packages/cli/test/diff-upgrade-plan.test.ts + read as cited, not reviewed: packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts (`registerPackageBody` step 2b), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`mergeObjectDefinitions`), packages/objectql/src/registry-object-registration.ts (`foldExtendersOntoDefinition`), packages/objectql/src/registry-top-level.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/package-upgrade-verdict.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-declared-renames.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/core/src/stack-collections.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts

First record on this PR; no earlier findings to close. Card #34095 read with comments 6899454419, 6918052417, 6918208447, 6918321707, 6922677907, 6922813677; PR comments 6921109056, 6922829814, 6922882363.

### ① Derived judgments

- `PackageUpgradeSide.objectExtensions` (optional input key): right. A side without it compares as on `main`; the CONTROL pin proves byte-identity.
- The fold in `objectsByName`: right against the registry. Owner is the base whatever the numbers, extensions spread `fields` by name in ascending `priority`, default `200`, ties in listed order (`registerPackageBody` 2b: `ext.priority ?? 200`; `contributors.sort`; `mergeObjectDefinitions` spread). The target key is `extend` verbatim: `computeFQN` is identity on `main`, so no namespace rewrite is missed.
- Extension-only objects never in `plan.objects.*`, compared against an empty other side: right. `readTouchedColumns` counts by `object` name, so their columns are read.
- Accept-set of the install-local door narrows: right in direction (ruling Q3 made real for extension fields), wider than the changeset says, see S1.
- `os diff`: prints more rows; no exit-code change (breaking count is printed only). Right.
- `sideOf` / `packageUpgradeSideOf` parity: same three keys, same reader. Right. The hosted `upgradeSideOf` stays with the cloud seat per the card.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on four packages with `!`, BREAKING banner and one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`) is the level AGENTS.md step 3 sets for a non-protocol narrowing. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand on both PR body and changeset: no authorable key or accepted value moves. `Check Changeset` and `Lint & Repo Gates` are green.

S1 (should-fix) — the changeset's BREAKING and "Who moves" text names two arms (extension field retyped; extension field dropped beside an added one, both 409). The diff publishes two more that it does not name:
  (a) an OWNED stored field dropped while an extension of the same object adds a stored field (or the reverse) is now a suspected rename, 409. On `main` the two sat in different collections and never paired. Follows from `objectsByName` merging both into one field map.
  (b) an extension field whose `renamedFrom` is a declared rename and whose new type stores no column now reaches `planInstallDeclaredRenames` as a `destructive` type change and is refused `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` reason `destructive_type` at step 2c″. No token answers it, so the stated fix (`--confirm-upgrade`) is wrong for this arm. `planDeclaredRenames` feeds `comparePackageVersions(...).typeChanges`, which now carries extension fields.
  Required: name both arms in the changeset and PR body with their fix, and pin (b) in `marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts` (its `destructive_type` cases are owned-field only).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question 1 (extension redeclaring a field of an owner outside the artifact is listed removed when the redeclaration stops): accept A. B would hand the comparison an environment reading against ruling record 6709061297 C3 (verdict decided by the two bodies alone). Errs toward a confirmation.
- Open question 2 / card note 6922813677 (card says "dropped (requires confirmation)"): accept A. `package-upgrade-verdict.ts` on `main` states removed fields are refused by nothing; the claim (6918321707) bars a new verdict category. A lone drop is listed with rows counted, which closes the measured rollback defect. The card line is superseded, not met; it is a seat route, so the maintainer reads it in 维护者速读 before landing.
- Deviation (pins in existing harness files, `diff.ts` edited): inside the claim's file surface for callers; accepted.
- Dev report: cloud-connection full suite and cli unit tier not run locally; `Test Core` 1–8/8 is green on this head.
- Check-runs on the head: every run success or skipped; no red.
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation or in-app join; column readings stay one `count` each, as before.
- Author login is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing makes an existing refusal real rather than taking a capability away: an extension field stores a column like an owned one, and ruling Q3 already asks the confirmation for that column. Tried to break it:

- Field on an object the package does not own: compared, never an object row. Holds.
- Removal across upgrade and rollback: listed, rows counted. Holds.
- Duplicate name between owner and extension: the extension's definition is compared, as the registry serves it. Holds; unpinned (N2).
- Renames: `renamedFrom` on an extension field flows through unchanged code; see S1 (b).
- Tests: red-first figures given per file; assertions are on plan content, status and `error.code`, not on mirrors. The dry-run case reads the test's own `fold`, as the PR body states.

N1 (nit) — ownership transition: an object owned on one side and extension-only on the other is listed in `plan.objects.*` AND has its fields compared, so every owner field is also a removed or added field (and can pair as suspected renames). Over-asks, never under-asks; unpinned and undocumented.
N2 (nit) — no pin for equal-priority order, for an extension overriding an owner's field, or for a declared rename of an extension field in `package-upgrade-plan.test.ts`.
N3 (nit) — the registry drops an extension's audit and `queue` fields where the base plans them (`foldExtendersOntoDefinition`); the comparison counts them. Over-lists only.
N4 (nit) — `diff.ts` `compared.includes` in a loop is quadratic in objects; a Set reads the same.

No must-fix. One should-fix (S1), open until a delta read.
